name: Microgrid restoration progress recorder
aliases: microgrids Microgrid black-start and restoration controls
summary: Records the requested, completed and failed stages of the assigned restoration attempt.
description: Records the requested, completed and failed stages of the assigned restoration attempt. Black-start and restoration control coordinates the establishment of an electrical reference and the gradual return of assigned resources and loads. A dead system, an available starting source and a successful load restoration are distinct states.

In a microgrid recovering from a blackout, an available grid-forming source can establish the assigned island reference before compatible generation and eligible load groups are introduced under the validated restoration strategy. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Restoration state events” at the input and “Restoration event history” at the output. Timestamp quality must remain available.
